mentions.name: NSFW Distraction-Focus Web Game
mentions.description: An NSFW browser game built in Rust and compiled to WASM that plays on players' sexual attractions to distract them while they attempt to stay focused and complete a series of challenges and activities, structured like a small laboratory experiment. Art and voice audio are provided by contracted artists and a voice actress.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm gonna try to create a video game that plays on people's sexual attractions, and tries to distract them while the player tries to complete a series of challenges/activities. It'll be like a little laboratory experiment, with NSFW graphics and the player having to remain focused while other things try to distract them.
